question: Does one shared residual-context direction learned from three confirmed circuit heads predict the restricted checkpoint map of the omitted fourth head?
evidence_status: Prospective instrument-only repair of invalid v1. V1 failed pred_a because its float32 discarded-energy certificate differed by 0.046875 against the frozen 2e-5 absolute bar. Its visible B/C/D values are quarantined and were not used to change any scientific choice.

repair.changed: The shared-context SVD now preserves caller-supplied float64. The same immutable float32 artifact is converted exactly to float64 before all decompositions, gauge rotations, Gram calculations, and random controls.
repair.unchanged: Maps, rank one, equal weights, four LOO folds, rotation seed 2308, random seed 2401, 256 random draws, all scientific and instrument bars, prediction meanings, zero-forward price, and no-rank-selection rule.
repair.bar_policy: The absolute 2e-5 certificate bar is not relaxed.

frozen_design.maps: Four occupied-reader-contracted maps, shape 1152x128, in route order L8H1, L9H1, L9H4, L11H3.
frozen_design.leave_one_out: Fit on three maps and score omitted-map captured energy for every head.
frozen_design.gauge_check: Four seed-2308 independent private orthogonal rotations.
frozen_design.random_control: Per omitted map, q99 of 256 seed-2401 isotropic physical rank-one projectors.
frozen_design.removal: Remove the pooled rank-one direction and compare median pairwise context-Gram similarity.

predictions.pred_a_authority_shapes_replay_certifica: All v1 repair authorities and immutable input hashes match; 4x1152x128 shapes, exact reconstruction, absolute SVD certificates, gauge invariance, raw Gram replay, finiteness, float64 liveness, and zero-forward price pass within 2e-5.
predictions.pred_b_rank1_context_core_predicts_every: Every omitted-head capture is at least 0.05 and exceeds its frozen isotropic-random q99.
predictions.pred_c_three_head_fits_identify_one_stab: Every pair of LOO physical projectors has squared overlap at least 0.85.
predictions.pred_d_removing_the_common_direction_red: Pooled rank-one removal lowers median pairwise context-Gram similarity by at least 0.05.

null: A failure leaves v1 and v2 scientifically invalid. With valid A, B or C failure rejects universal rank-one shared capability; D failure rejects rank one as a material explanation of broad common Gram geometry.
decision: A--C nominate but do not identify or adopt a shared rank-one checkpoint capability. No higher rank is selected. Causal common-core/private-tail swaps remain gated behind downstream reader identification and unopened v24.
